posts.description: From the foreword of The Vignelli Canon , first published in 2010. posts.title: Small acts of defiance
posts.description: I’ve been descending down the rabbit hole of self hosting recently. My motivation is the usual disquiet about Big Tech and data privacy, and a general annoyance that nobody sells software any more. Nothing particularly original or worthy of further discussion.
